reason: The Verify button's onClick (WorkflowStepContainer.tsx, patch lines 256-263) sends `form.getValues(...sendTo) || ""` and `verificationCode` with no emptiness check, and it is disabled only while `verifyPhoneNumberMutation.isLoading`. The `required` attribute on the TextField does not stop a plain onClick, and the server input uses bare `z.string()` (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/workflows.tsx:1084-1085), which accepts empty strings. The patch only re-indents this block when it drops the `isSenderIdNeeded` wrapper; the same logic existed before.
